common.notes: Vishti (Bhadra) is avoided for auspicious beginnings; Rahu Kala is avoided; Abhijit is preferred when free. Rikta tithis (4, 9, 14) and Amavasya are avoided by all events below. Tarabala and Chandrabala are personal filters used when birth data is available.
